chunk.content: The 'tuna' label is pinned at genus level to Thunnus (family Scombridae), which the FAO Scombrids of the World catalogue treats as seven species: T. alalunga, T. albacares, T. atlanticus, T. maccoyii, T. obesus, T. thynnus and T. tonggol.
chunk.source_quote: Thunnus: Thunnus alalunga, Thunnus albacares, Thunnus atlanticus, Thunnus maccoyii, Thunnus obesus, Thunnus thynnus, Thunnus tonggol

source.title: FAO Species Catalogue Vol. 2: Scombrids of the World (tunas, mackerels, bonitos)
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
